title: A Brand-New Tire Can Still Be Mounted in the Wrong Direction
topic: Directional tires must rotate in the direction specified by the sidewall arrow
mechanicTruth: A directional tire is designed to rotate in one direction and should be installed so its molded rotation arrow matches forward wheel rotation; directional and asymmetric tire requirements are not the same thing.
